hero.h1: Connecting exceptional fragrance houses with the Libyan market.
hero.lead: REMAL imports, represents and distributes fragrance brands across Libya — the bridge between the world's perfume houses and a nationwide network of retailers.
about.p1: REMAL is a Libyan company dedicated to the import and distribution of fine fragrances. We represent perfume houses in the Libyan market and place their collections with the right distributors, perfumeries and points of sale in every major city.
about.p2: Like sand carried across the desert, we move fragrance from where it is made to where it is loved — with care for the brand, its image and its customer.
alt.hero: A perfume bottle on volcanic rock
pf.soonh: Selected houses, on their way to Libya.
e.phone: Enter a valid phone number, e.g. +218 91 234 5678.
chain.p: REMAL is the link that brings a fragrance brand into Libya and manages its journey to every retailer.
s3.p: Distributors and retailers in Misrata, and a growing network.
s4.p: Perfumeries and points of sale nationwide.
s5.p: The right fragrance, available near them.
fb.p: Entering a new market takes more than shipping stock. REMAL handles every step on the ground, so your brand arrives correctly, is presented properly, and stays on shelves.
v1.p: Market insight, pricing positioning and a launch plan built for Libyan retail.
v2.p: Customs clearance, product registration and full regulatory handling.
v3.p: Controlled storage and stock management for fragrance.
v4.p: A distributor network that starts in Misrata and grows to reach perfumeries across the country.
v5.p: Merchandising, retailer education and marketing that protect your brand image.
map.p: We are based in Misrata, serving the Libyan market through a steadily growing network of distributors and retailers.
pt.p: Whether you own a fragrance brand looking for representation in Libya, or a perfumery that wants to carry our brands — tell us about you and our team will respond within two working days.

f.note: We reply within two working days.
